_avail.description: Stereo pre-amplifier/mixer with 2 mono / stereo volume zones, 4 line inputs, 2 MIC/Line inputs with 48V phantom power adn1 emergency input, 2 U 19" rack mount, black
_avail.portsMissing: Not stated: connector type of the balanced zone outputs (set to other) and whether each is one stereo connector; the mute all contact is in the Emergency In notes

ports.label: Emergency In
ports.notes: Balanced 0 dBV line level, isolated; triggered by VOX or potential-free contact on the mute all connection

ports.label: Mic A In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; +48 V phantom switchable; VOX; ALINP compatible

ports.label: Mic A In (RCA)
ports.notes: Stereo line on RCA, mono summed with the Euroblock input

ports.label: Mic B In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; +48 V phantom switchable; ALINP compatible

ports.label: Mic B In (RCA)
ports.notes: Stereo line on RCA, mono summed with the Euroblock input

ports.label: Zone 1 Out (Balanced)
ports.notes: Balanced line output, mono/stereo switch; connector type not stated

ports.label: Zone 1 Out (RCA)
ports.notes: Unbalanced line output on RCA, mono/stereo switch

ports.label: Zone 2 Out (Balanced)
ports.notes: Balanced line output, mono/stereo switch; connector type not stated

ports.label: Zone 2 Out (RCA)
ports.notes: Unbalanced line output on RCA, mono/stereo switch

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: 100-240 V AC mains inlet (appliance coupler) with switch and fuse; IEC inlet type not stated; inlet type not stated ("appliance coupler")
